results.text: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not the text of the act] Placeholder paragraph 1: in the absence of a placeholder decision, a controller may transfer personal data to a third country only if the controller has provided appropriate placeholder safeguards, and on condition that enforceable rights and effective legal remedies are available.

[SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not the text of the act] Placeholder paragraph 1: a transfer of personal data to a third country may take place where the placeholder authority has decided that the third country ensures an adequate level of protection. Such a transfer shall not require any specific authorisation.
